煙訓練

A practiced emergency procedure used by flight or cabin crew to respond to smoke or fire in the aircraft.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 煙訓練?

In this glossary, 煙訓練 refers to: A practiced emergency procedure used by flight or cabin crew to respond to smoke or fire in the aircraft.

How is 煙訓練 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "客室乗務員は後部ギャレーで煙を検知した後、煙訓練を開始した。"

Why does 煙訓練 matter in aviation?

煙訓練 matters because it supports clear communication in Emergencies contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses 煙訓練?

煙訓練 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does 煙訓練 belong to?

In this glossary, 煙訓練 is grouped under Emergencies. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A practiced emergency procedure used by flight or cabin crew to respond to smoke or fire in the aircraft.

Operational example

The cabin crew initiated a smoke drill after detecting smoke in the aft galley.

Localized term

煙訓練

Localized example

客室乗務員は後部ギャレーで煙を検知した後、煙訓練を開始した。
